I finished the level in 28 actions. The human baseline is 22 and the cap was 110, so I spent about 1.3 times the baseline.

**How the level works:**
- A dotted line runs from the ball to a white square in the bottom-left corner.
- Clicking the next dot on the line moves the square one step toward the ball. The dots are 2 cells apart on a diagonal.
- The black cross shows where the first step goes.
- The level ends when the square reaches the ball.
- Clicks on the ball, the empty lower area, the square itself, or dots further along the line do nothing. They still count as actions and use up the bottom bar, which acts as a click budget.
- Clicks in the top area do nothing and do not use up the bar. Undo (action 7) showed no change.
